label: Brief-uploads
description: Prepare a one-page brief for the Mara Heritage Bank chair on the single most material strategic decision queued at the Q3 board meeting: how to allocate the projected Q4 capital headroom — between accelerating digital transformation, repurposing into SME lending, or holding for capital strength. The brief should frame the trade-off, summarise the evidence on each option, and name the recommended path.
objective: Give the chair a clear, decision-ready read on the capital allocation choice in time to set the board's discussion frame.
scope: Mara Heritage Bank — Chair (single reader). Decision window: Q3 2025 board meeting. Confidentiality: Confidential. Length: 1-2 pages.
